LANDING.HEADLINE: Every pick on the record. Locked before kickoff.
LANDING.SUBHEADLINE: An honest, automatic record of every pick, wherever you post it. Discord, Telegram, the web or your own app.
LANDING.INTRO: OpenCapper keeps an honest record of your picks without extra work. Post a pick where you already are, in a Discord server, a Telegram chat or on the web. We note the odds at that moment, grade it after the game and add it to your public profile. Wins and losses both stay, nothing gets deleted, and cappers are ranked by return on investment instead of win rate.

FEATURES.TITLE: Features
FEATURES.ODDS_BODY: The price, the bookmaker and the time come from the market, never from the capper.
FEATURES.LOCKED_BODY: A pick is accepted only while the event has not started. After that it cannot be edited or deleted.
FEATURES.GRADED_BODY: Final scores settle every pick as win, loss, push or void. Nobody grades their own record.
FEATURES.CLV_BODY: Every pick is compared with the closing price, the clearest sign of skill over a short sample.
FEATURES.LOG_BODY: Each pick extends a sha256 chain. The root is anchored once a day with OpenTimestamps.
FEATURES.ROI_BODY: Units and return on investment after a minimum sample. A bigger stake buys no rank.
FEATURES.AFFILIATE_BODY: We earn nothing when you deposit or lose. The only product is an accurate record.

VERIFY.TITLE: For the skeptics
VERIFY.BODY: You do not have to trust us. Every pick gets a fingerprint the moment it is locked, and each fingerprint is tied to the one before it. If anyone changed a single pick, the chain would stop adding up and everyone could see it.
VERIFY.STEP_2: Hash canonical with sha256. It must equal leaf.
VERIFY.STEP_3: Hash the bytes of prevRoot followed by leaf. It must equal root.
VERIFY.STEP_4: Compare root with the log head and the daily OpenTimestamps proof.
VERIFY.POINT_CHECK_BODY: Open the verify page, enter a pick and your own browser does the math. No account needed.
VERIFY.POINT_STAMP_BODY: Once a day the latest fingerprint is written into Bitcoin, so not even we can rewrite the past.
VERIFY.POINT_SOURCE_BODY: The code that grades and records picks is public. Read it, or run your own copy.
VERIFY.DETAILS_BODY: Each log entry carries the canonical JSON of the pick and the hashes around it. The chain is sha256, the daily proof is OpenTimestamps. Four steps and any sha256 tool are enough.

HOW.TITLE: How it works
HOW.STEP_1_BODY: The moment a capper makes a pick, we seal it: the game, the selection, the odds, the stake and the time.
HOW.STEP_2_BODY: Each new pick is linked to all picks before it. Changing an old pick would break that chain, and everyone would see it.
HOW.STEP_3_BODY: Once a day a fingerprint of the whole history is stamped into Bitcoin. After that, not even we can rewrite it.

DEV.TITLE: For developers
DEV.DESCRIPTION: The hashes, the raw log entries, the API and the Bitcoin proofs, so you can check everything with your own tools.
DEV.STEP_1_BODY: When a pick is locked we write its fixed fields (id, capper, sequence number, event, market, selection, line, odds, bookmaker, units and lock time) as a short JSON text and compute its SHA 256 hash. That hash is the leaf.
DEV.STEP_2_BODY: The new root is the SHA 256 hash of the previous root followed by the new leaf. Changing any old pick would change every root after it, so a quiet edit is impossible to hide.
DEV.STEP_3_TITLE: The chain is anchored in Bitcoin
DEV.STEP_3_BODY: Once a day the current root is sent to the public OpenTimestamps calendars, which commit it into a Bitcoin transaction. Anyone can download the proof and check it without asking us.
DEV.STEP_4_BODY: The whole log is exported through a public API. Rebuild the chain from the first entry and compare your final root with the head shown below and with the anchored roots.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy policy
PRIVACY.DESCRIPTION: How {appName} processes personal data: accounts, picks, the public pick log, imported public profiles and your rights under the GDPR.
PRIVACY.INTRO: This policy explains which personal data {appName} ({site}) processes, for which purposes, on which legal basis and for how long, and which rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). {appName} is a public record of sports picks. It does not offer betting, takes no stakes and has no paid features.
PRIVACY.CONTROLLER_BODY: The controller within the meaning of Art. 4(7) GDPR is the provider named in the legal notice:
PRIVACY.CONTROLLER_DPO: We have not appointed a data protection officer, as we are not legally required to do so.
PRIVACY.HOSTING_SERVER: The website and its database run on a server rented from netcup GmbH in a data center in Germany. netcup processes data on our behalf under a data processing agreement (Art. 28 GDPR).
PRIVACY.HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE: All requests pass through Cloudflare (Cloudflare, Inc., USA), which we use as content delivery network, reverse proxy and protection against attacks. Cloudflare necessarily processes your IP address, the requested address, browser information and the time of the request, and may set technically necessary security cookies. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; transfers to the USA are based on the adequacy decision of the European Commission (Art. 45 GDPR).
PRIVACY.HOSTING_LOGS: Technical logs of the server software are kept only as long as needed to operate and secure the service, for at most 14 days.
PRIVACY.HOSTING_BASIS: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is a fast, secure and available website.
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_INTRO: You do not need an account to read the site. To log picks on the website you sign in with Discord, Google or Telegram, depending on which providers are offered. We do not store passwords. Depending on the provider we receive and store:
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_DISCORD: Discord: your Discord user ID, username, avatar and the email address of your Discord account (permissions "identify" and "email").
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_GOOGLE: Google: your Google account ID, name, email address and profile picture.
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_TELEGRAM: Telegram: your Telegram user ID, username or name and profile picture, as signed by the Telegram login widget. Telegram does not share an email address; we store a placeholder instead.
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_DETAILS: From this we create a public profile with a username and avatar. We also store the tokens issued by the login provider, your role (user, moderator or administrator) and, if an account is suspended, the reason and duration of the suspension. If you sign in with another provider that uses the same verified email address, it is linked to the same account.
PRIVACY.ACCOUNT_BASIS: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of the user agreement).
PRIVACY.COOKIES_INTRO: We only use cookies and local storage that are strictly necessary for the service or that store a setting you chose yourself (§ 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG). We use no analytics, tracking or advertising cookies.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_SESSION: Session cookie: keeps you logged in for up to 30 days. With the session we store when it was created, your IP address and your browser's user agent, to protect your account.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_OAUTH: Login cookies: short lived cookies that secure the redirect to Discord or Google and back.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_THEME: "user-theme" cookie: your appearance settings, only if you change them (one year).
PRIVACY.COOKIES_TABLES: "data-tables" cookie: column, sorting and page size settings of tables, only if you change them (one year).
PRIVACY.COOKIES_MODE: "theme" in local storage: your choice of light or dark mode.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_LOCALE: The interface language follows the address you open. We do not set a language cookie.
PRIVACY.PICKS_BODY: The purpose of {appName} is a public, verifiable track record. When you log a pick, on the website or through our Discord or Telegram bot, we store the event, market, selection, the odds captured by our server, the stake in units, the bookmaker the price came from, the time and the sequence number, and later the result and closing odds. Picks are published on your profile, on the leaderboard and in the pick log.
PRIVACY.PICKS_LOG: Every pick is written into an append only, hash chained log: a SHA-256 hash of the pick, which contains an internal numeric user ID but not your name, is chained to all previous entries, and once a day the current root hash is timestamped through public OpenTimestamps calendars. This lets anyone check that no pick was changed, deleted or backdated. Once a pick is locked it can therefore neither be edited nor deleted, by you or by us; the database rejects such changes.
PRIVACY.PICKS_BASIS: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, because a permanent, tamper evident record is the service you use, and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, our legitimate interest and that of the public in the integrity of every published record. Deleting a single pick would invalidate the proofs of all later picks of all users.
PRIVACY.BOTS_BODY: If you log picks through our Discord or Telegram bot, the bot sends us your Discord or Telegram user ID, your username and the ID of the server or chat where you used it. We use the server or chat ID to post results and recaps there. Your messages are also processed by Discord or Telegram under their own privacy policies. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
PRIVACY.IMPORTED_INTRO: To make publicly made betting claims verifiable, {appName} also tracks people who publish picks or trades elsewhere, without them signing up:
PRIVACY.IMPORTED_POLYMARKET: Polymarket: public trades of selected accounts, taken from Polymarket's public data and the public Polygon blockchain: wallet address, public profile name and picture, and trades with transaction hash, time and price.
PRIVACY.IMPORTED_REDDIT: Reddit, only while this import is enabled: picks posted publicly in r/sportsbook threads, with the Reddit username, a link to the comment and its text.
PRIVACY.IMPORTED_DETAILS: For these we create a profile marked as public and imported (not claimed). Each imported pick is locked at the time of import, graded like any other pick and linked to the original post or transaction. Such a profile never shows a verified badge and states that the person has not signed up. The data comes from the platforms named above (Art. 14 GDPR); we process only what the person published there themselves, and no special categories of personal data.
PRIVACY.IMPORTED_BASIS: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest, and that of the public, is transparency about betting results that people claim publicly in front of an audience.
PRIVACY.IMPORTED_RIGHTS: If a profile is yours, you can claim it, object to the processing or ask us to hide it: use the claim link on the profile page or write to {email}. After an objection we hide the profile and stop the import, unless compelling legitimate grounds override your interests. Picks already in the hash chained log remain as anonymised entries (see "Deleting your account").
PRIVACY.SOURCES_TITLE: Data sources that receive no visitor data
PRIVACY.SOURCES_BODY: Our server retrieves sports data from The Odds API (odds, schedules and scores), TheSportsDB (team logos, delivered to you through our own server), Polymarket (public market data) and, when enabled, the Reddit API. These requests contain no data about our visitors. The OpenTimestamps calendars, operated by third parties, receive only a 32 byte hash of the log, never personal data.
PRIVACY.EXTERNAL_INTRO: Some content is loaded by your browser directly from other servers, which thereby receive your IP address:
PRIVACY.EXTERNAL_AVATARS: Profile pictures from Discord, Google, Telegram or Polymarket, when a profile with such a picture is shown.
PRIVACY.EXTERNAL_TELEGRAM: The Telegram login widget (telegram.org), only after you open the Telegram login.
PRIVACY.EXTERNAL_FONTS: Google Fonts (Google Ireland Limited), only if you choose a custom font in the appearance settings.
PRIVACY.EXTERNAL_BASIS: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for showing profiles as their owners published them, and Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR for the login widget and a font you chose yourself.
PRIVACY.RECIPIENTS_BODY: We do not sell personal data and do not share it for advertising. Apart from the public content of the site, personal data only reaches the processors and services named in this policy.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_SESSIONS: Sessions: until you log out, at most 30 days.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_ACCOUNT: Account data: as long as the account exists.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_PICKS: Picks, results and log entries: permanently, because the public log depends on them.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_RATE: IP addresses for rate limiting of the login: in memory only, for the length of the limit window.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BACKUPS: Database backups: rotated automatically and kept for at most six months.
PRIVACY.DELETION_BODY: You can ask us at {email} to delete your account. We then remove your identity data (username, avatar, email address, linked login accounts and sessions), hide your profile and remove it from the leaderboard. Your picks remain in the public log as an anonymised record under the internal numeric ID, without name or picture, because removing them would invalidate the proofs of all later picks. There is no self service deletion yet; we handle requests manually within one month.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_BODY: Under the GDPR you have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18) and data portability (Art. 20). Where we process data on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, you may object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation (Art. 21 GDPR). Where an exception under Art. 17(3) GDPR applies to picks in the public log, we anonymise them instead of deleting them. Send requests to {email}.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_COMPLAINT: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the member state of your habitual residence, your place of work or the place of the alleged infringement (Art. 77 GDPR).
PRIVACY.MINORS_BODY: {appName} is not directed at persons under 18. Accounts of minors that come to our attention are removed.
PRIVACY.CHANGES_BODY: We update this policy when the service or the law changes. The date at the top shows the current version.
PRIVACY.CONTACT_BODY: Questions about data protection and requests regarding your rights: {email}.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of use
TERMS.DESCRIPTION: Rules for using {appName}: an informational pick tracker, no betting service, public and permanent picks.
TERMS.INTRO: These terms govern the use of {site} and of the {appName} Discord and Telegram bots, provided by the operator named in the legal notice. By signing in or logging a pick you accept them.
TERMS.SERVICE_BODY: {appName} is a free tool that records sports picks at odds captured by our server, grades them against the results and publishes a verifiable track record. {appName} is not a bookmaker or betting exchange: it accepts no stakes, places no bets, pays no winnings, processes no payments and has no affiliate or referral agreements with sportsbooks. Bookmaker names and logos only identify the source of a quoted price.
TERMS.INFO_BODY: All content on {appName} is for information and entertainment. Picks, statistics, rankings and odds are not betting, financial or investment advice and not a recommendation to place a bet. Past results do not predict future results. Whether sports betting is legal for you depends on the law where you live, and you are responsible for complying with it. Gambling can be addictive; if it becomes a problem, seek help from a support service near you.
TERMS.ACCOUNT_BODY: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and log picks. You sign in through Discord, Google or Telegram and are responsible for keeping that account secure. One person, one account: do not create accounts for other people or several accounts for yourself.
TERMS.PICKS_BODY: A pick is locked when you submit it: our server captures the price at that moment, the pick is published with your username and written into the public hash chained log. Picks are only accepted before the event starts. Locked picks cannot be edited, withdrawn or deleted, not even when your account is deleted; they then remain as an anonymised record (see the privacy policy).
TERMS.ACCURACY_BODY: Odds, schedules, scores and results come from third party data providers and public market data. We grade picks automatically and with care, but odds may be delayed or wrong, events may be postponed or cancelled, and grading may contain errors. We correct obvious grading errors where possible; the result is the only part of a pick that can change. There is no entitlement to a particular grade, ranking or availability of the service.
TERMS.IMPORTED_BODY: {appName} also shows records imported from public posts and on chain trades of people who have not signed up. These profiles are marked as imported. The person concerned can claim such a profile, dispute it or ask for it to be hidden, as described in the privacy policy.
TERMS.CONDUCT_FAKE: create fake, duplicate or impersonating accounts, or claim a profile that is not yours;
TERMS.CONDUCT_MANIPULATION: manipulate records, rankings or grading, for example by exploiting errors in captured odds or timing, or by automated mass submission;
TERMS.CONDUCT_ABUSE: attack or overload the service, scrape it beyond normal use, or bypass rate limits or access controls;
TERMS.CONDUCT_CONTENT: use your username, avatar or the bots for unlawful, offensive or misleading content, or to advertise betting services;
TERMS.CONDUCT_LAW: use the service in breach of applicable law.
TERMS.MODERATION_BODY: Moderators and administrators can review accounts and picks. If you breach these terms or the law, we may suspend your account temporarily or permanently, taking your legitimate interests into account. A suspended account cannot sign in or log picks; picks already locked remain in the public log. If you think a measure was wrong, contact us at {email}.
TERMS.CONTENT_BODY: You keep the rights to what you submit. You grant us a free, worldwide, non exclusive and permanent right to store, display and publish your picks, username and avatar in the public log, rankings, share images and exports, as far as needed to operate the service. Because the log is permanent, this right cannot be revoked for picks that are already locked.
TERMS.OPEN_SOURCE_BODY: The source code of {appName} is published under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPLv3) at {githubUrl}. That license covers the code only. It grants no rights to the content of the site, such as picks, profiles and rankings, or to the {appName} name and logo.
TERMS.CHANGES_BODY: The service is free of charge and provided as available. We may change, restrict or discontinue features or the whole service at any time. We may change these terms with effect for the future and announce significant changes on the site. If you do not agree, you can stop using the service and ask us to delete your account.
TERMS.LIABILITY_BODY: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence, for injury to life, body or health, and under the German Product Liability Act. For slight negligence we are liable only for the breach of an essential contractual obligation, meaning an obligation whose fulfilment makes the proper performance of the agreement possible in the first place and on whose fulfilment you may regularly rely, and limited to the foreseeable damage typical for this kind of agreement. Otherwise our liability for slight negligence is excluded. Bets you place elsewhere are your own decision and at your own risk.
TERMS.LAW_BODY: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. If you are a consumer with your habitual residence in another country, this choice of law does not deprive you of the protection of the mandatory provisions of the law of that country. If a provision of these terms is invalid, the remaining provisions stay in effect.
TERMS.CONTACT_BODY: Questions about these terms: {email} or our Discord server.
